name: Wynter
tagline: On-demand message and landing page testing against a panel of vetted B2B professionals.

pricing.notes: AI-drafted from a site submission; price unverified.

verdictSummary: The software here is a survey builder with a nice report view, which an agent will hand you before lunch. The product you are actually buying is a recruited, screened panel of B2B people with real job titles who will read your homepage and tell you it makes no sense, within a day or two. Recruiting, screening, incentivizing and policing that panel is an operations business, not a coding problem, and fraudulent respondents are the default state of the internet. You can absolutely build the testing instrument and point it at your own customers, prospects or Slack communities, which is a genuinely useful thing to own. But if you have nobody to send it to, the tool is an empty room with good lighting.
coreLoopDIY: A self-hosted message testing app where you upload a page screenshot or copy block, attach a fixed question set, send tokenized links to reviewers you recruit yourself, and read aggregated scores plus verbatim comments.
requirements: Node 20 and a place to run it
Your own list of reviewers who match your ICP
Optional: a transactional email provider key if you want to send invites from the app
whatYouLose: The panel itself: screened professionals by seniority, industry and company size, available on demand
Turnaround in a day or two instead of you begging six people in DMs
Fraud and quality control on responses, including attention checks and moderation
Cross-account benchmarks that tell you whether a 3.1 clarity score is bad or normal
Incentive handling, payouts and the legal plumbing that comes with paying strangers
moatNotes: Panel supply is the whole business: the hard part is having a screened VP of Ops available on a Tuesday, not rendering a five point scale.
whyPeopleStillPay: Because the alternative is asking your existing customers, who already understand your product and therefore cannot tell you whether your homepage makes sense to a stranger. Getting cold, title-matched B2B buyers to spend fifteen focused minutes on your copy is expensive and annoying, and doing it repeatedly is a recruiting operation with a payments function attached. Teams pay to skip all of that and get structured feedback while the redesign argument is still live. The report is the receipt, not the product.
notes: The instrument is a one-sitting build; the respondents are not. The moat is a screened, incentivized B2B panel you can summon on demand, plus enough cross-account data to know what a normal score looks like.
prompt:
Build a self-hosted B2B message testing tool called "Panelless" in an empty folder.

Stack, no substitutions: Next.js 15 App Router with TypeScript, Tailwind, SQLite via better-sqlite3, Zod for validation. No auth provider, no analytics, no telemetry, no cloud services.

Data model:
- Test: id, name, stimulus_type (image | text | url), stimulus (file path, markdown, or url), created_at, status (draft | live | closed)
- Question: id, test_id, kind (scale_1_5 | single_choice | open_text), prompt, choices JSON nullable, order
- Reviewer: id, test_id, label, email nullable, token (random 24 chars), invited_at, completed_at
- Answer: id, reviewer_id, question_id, value_number nullable, value_text nullable

Admin side, protected by a single ADMIN_PASSWORD from .env checked in middleware with a signed cookie:
- Create a test, upload a screenshot to ./uploads or paste a markdown copy block
- Seed each new test with a default question set: clarity of what the product does (1-5), who it is for (open), what it does (open), most confusing thing (open), what is missing before you would buy (open), likelihood to book a demo (1-5)
- Add, edit, reorder, delete questions
- Bulk-add reviewers by pasting one label or email per line, which generates tokens
- Copy invite links, and optionally send them via Resend if RESEND_API_KEY is set in .env; skip sending silently if it is not

Reviewer side at /r/[token], no login:
- Show the stimulus, then one question per screen, saving each answer immediately
- Enforce a minimum of 40 characters on open_text answers and reject answers submitted in under 5 seconds as a crude attention check, flagging them rather than blocking
- Thank you screen, and refuse to reopen a completed token

Results page per test:
- Mean and distribution bars for each scale question
- All verbatim answers grouped by question, with flagged low-effort responses visually dimmed
- Copy-all-verbatims button and a CSV export

Explicitly out of scope: recruiting or paying respondents, panel sourcing, benchmarks against other companies, video recording, multi-tenant accounts, billing.

Include a seed script that creates one demo test with three fake completed reviewers, a .env.example with ADMIN_PASSWORD and RESEND_API_KEY, and a README that states plainly that this tool assumes you already have people to send it to.
